title: Another Massachusetts State Trooper Faces a Drunken Driving Charge. What Will Maura Healey Do About It?
summary: Massachusetts state trooper Carol Leurini faces another drunken driving charge after playing pickleball. Governor Maura Healey says she'll speak with the State Police colonel.

title: New Hampshire State Rep Race Decided By One Vote
summary: Democrat Vivian Marie Hall defeated Republican Michael Visconti by one vote after a recount in Franklin, New Hampshire.
